name: HoldingCardAction

props.description: Render the child link as the action.
props.name: asChild

props.description: Accessible name when the label is not enough.

tagline: A quiet glyph + label action of a HoldingCard (gh#1439): edit, remove. A `<button>` by default; `asChild` turns a router link into it.
usage: DO name a destructive action with the item ("Remove Pikachu") through aria-label.
